question: What must be done with the fire-pit and the Śiva-fire according to rule?
premises: The fire-pit must be consecrated according to rule.
The Śiva-fire must be brought in according to rule.
These actions are part of the ritual sequence.
inference: One should consecrate the fire-pit according to rule and lead the Śiva-fire into it according to rule.
plain_english: Having consecrated the fire-pit according to rule, one should lead the Śiva-fire into it according to rule.
